familytree.variant.title: %s's variant
familytree.variant.note.hidden_gene: It shows a gene its parents carried hidden.
familytree.variant.note.axolotl: Rare mutation: a bred axolotl is blue 1 time in 1,200.
familytree.variant.note.mooshroom: Rare mutation: same-colored parents have a 1 in 1,024 chance of this.
familytree.command.menu_hint: Press %s to open Family Tree, or use /familytree menu for the chest menu.
familytree.command.list.more: ...and %s more. Open the Family Tree screen to search them.
familytree.command.info.horse_stats: speed: %s blocks/s, jump: %s blocks, health: %s hearts
familytree.command.scan.result: Family Tree scan complete: imported %s pets, refreshed %s existing records.
familytree.command.locate.deceased_resul: %s died on day %s. Last known location: %s in %s
familytree.command.locate.no_position: No known location for %s yet. Try /familytree scan while the pet is loaded.
familytree.command.pair.same_parent: Parent A and Parent B must be different animals.
familytree.command.pair.child_matches_pa: The child must be different from both parents.
familytree.command.pair.species_mismatch: Use animals of the same species, or a horse and a donkey as parents of a mule.
familytree.command.pair.cycle: Can't link these animals. An animal can't be its own ancestor.
familytree.command.setage.invalid: Cannot set age to %s days when the latest valid world day is %s.
familytree.command.setage.result: Set %s to %s days old. Birth day is now %s.
familytree.command.setage.result_one: Set %s to 1 day old. Birth day is now %s.

familytree.command.setbirth.result: Set %s to be born on day %s. Relative age is now %s days.
familytree.command.setbirth.result_one: Set %s to be born on day %s. Relative age is now 1 day.
familytree.command.info.help.title: Family Tree records your tamed pets and the animals you breed, name, or add: parents, names, owners, and deaths.
familytree.command.info.help.summary: Use the Family Tree screen or /familytree menu to browse pets and lineage, or use commands to manage data directly.
familytree.command.info.help.commands: Commands: /familytree menu, /familytree list, /familytree scan, /familytree pair, /familytree breed, /familytree unpair, /familytree setage, /familytree setbirth, /familytree prune, /familytree info <name>.
familytree.command.info.help.scan: /familytree scan imports already-tamed pets that are loaded in the world and refreshes animals already in the history.
familytree.command.info.help.pair: /familytree pair links two parents to a child record.
familytree.command.info.help.unpair: /familytree unpair clears the parent links from a child record.
familytree.command.info.help.setage: /familytree setage changes a pet to a relative age in world days, for example 15 days old.
familytree.command.info.help.setbirth: /familytree setbirth sets the pet's birth day directly, for example born on day 20.
familytree.tool.not_tamed: That animal is not tamed, so it cannot be linked.
familytree.tool.ride_first: Ride this animal once so Family Tree records it, then try again.
familytree.tool.not_recorded: This server doesn't record new animals of this species (%s).
familytree.tool.farm_full: This server's Family Tree already keeps %s unnamed farm animals. Name this animal with a name tag to add it.
familytree.screen.load_failed: No complete reply. Choose Refresh or reopen the screen.
familytree.parents.title: Parents of %s
familytree.parents.hint: Choose two parents, then confirm. This changes the recorded family, not the animals in your world.
familytree.parents.clear_hint: The pet and its descendants stay in the tree.
familytree.parents.distinct: Choose two different parents. Neither can be the child.
familytree.parents.failed: The pet record changed. Refresh the tree and try again.
familytree.parents.no_candidates: No pets match. Try another name or visit your pets first.
familytree.help.title: Start your animals' family tree
familytree.help.discover: Visit pets you already have, then choose Find existing pets. Only loaded tamed pets can be discovered.
familytree.help.parents: Older parents are unknown. Open a pet, select it, and choose Add parents to record a family you remember. You must own all three pets or be an operator.
familytree.help.breed: Breed animals while Family Tree is installed. Each baby joins the tree with both parents, so you can follow a line across generations. Animals that die stay in the tree.
familytree.help.animals: Other animals join when you breed them, use a name tag on them, or click them with the linking stick. Wild animals stay out until you do.
familytree.help.export: Choose Export family tree, then Open folder to find the PNG. Hide branches to make a smaller image. The file stays on your computer.
familytree.command.cooldown: Wait a moment before you try that again.
familytree.command.read_only: Family Tree found an unsupported save format. Edits are disabled to preserve the original data. Check the server log.
familytree.command.ambiguous: More than one pet matches '%s'. Click one of the choices below, or use its exact UUID.
familytree.command.backup: Saved a backup in familytree-backups/%s before pruning.
familytree.command.backup_failed: Prune canceled because a backup could not be saved. Check the server log.
familytree.permission.denied: You don't have permission for that (%s).
familytree.command.admin_usage: Admins: /familytree reload reads the server settings again, and /familytree settings shows them.
familytree.reload.read_failed: Could not read %s, so Family Tree kept its current settings. Check the server log.
familytree.config.not_boolean: %1$s must be true or false, not '%2$s'. Using %3$s.
familytree.config.not_number: %1$s must be a whole number from %3$s to %4$s, not '%2$s'. Using %5$s.
familytree.config.out_of_range: %1$s must be from %3$s to %4$s, not %2$s. Using %5$s.
familytree.config.not_choice: %1$s must be one of %3$s, not '%2$s'. Using %4$s.
familytree.config.bad_name: %1$s must be 1 to 50 characters without formatting codes, not '%2$s'. Using %3$s.
familytree.config.bad_language: %1$s must be auto or a language code such as de_de, not '%2$s'. Using %3$s.
familytree.config.bad_species: %1$s: '%2$s' is not a species id such as minecraft:fox. Skipping it.
familytree.config.bad_alias: %1$s: '%2$s' may only use lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Skipping it.
familytree.config.unknown_key: Family Tree has no setting named %s. Check its spelling.
familytree.config.unknown_species: %1$s: Minecraft has no species %2$s. Check the spelling, or install its mod.
familytree.config.language_fallback: serverLanguage: Family Tree has no %1$s translation, so it uses %2$s.
familytree.config.restart: %s changes take effect after /reload or a restart.
familytree.settings.header: Family Tree settings from %s. Permission nodes: %s.
familytree.settings.hint: Use /familytree settings all to list every setting.
familytree.farm.limit: This server's Family Tree keeps up to %s unnamed farm animals and is full, so this baby wasn't recorded. A name tag still records an animal. An operator can run /familytree prune farm or raise farmRecordLimit.
familytree.farm.limit_parents: This server's Family Tree keeps up to %s unnamed farm animals and is full, so these parents weren't recorded. A name tag still records an animal.
familytree.menu.title: Family Tree
familytree.menu.wait: Wait a moment, then try again.
familytree.menu.disabled: The server turned off the Family Tree chest menu.
familytree.menu.players_only: Only players can open the Family Tree menu.
familytree.menu.help: Click a pet to see its parents, grandparents, and children. Owners can rename a pet, add its parents, and locate it.
familytree.menu.search.title: Search
familytree.menu.search.hint: Click to type a name or species
familytree.menu.discover.hint: Records tamed pets that are loaded in the world
familytree.menu.view_only: Only the owner or an operator can change this pet.
familytree.menu.book.hint: Read this family as a book
familytree.menu.pick.title: Parent %s for %s
familytree.help.feedback: Found a bug or want a feature? Choose Send feedback to write to the developer. The screen shows everything that will be sent, and nothing leaves your computer until you press Send.
familytree.tooltip.name: Family Tree: %s
familytree.waypoint.tooltip: Add a waypoint for this pet in %s
familytree.waypoint.failed: Could not add the waypoint in %s. Check the game log.
familytree.waypoint.busy: Wait a moment before asking for another waypoint.
familytree.waypoint.no_position: Family Tree has no location for this pet yet. Visit it so its location is recorded.
familytree.feedback.title: Send feedback to the Family Tree developer
familytree.feedback.message_hint: What works, what doesn't, or what you'd like next
familytree.feedback.contact_hint: Email or Discord name, if you'd like a reply
familytree.feedback.preview: This is everything that will be sent:
familytree.feedback.notice: Nothing is sent until you press Send, and Family Tree never sends anything on its own. The feedback server sees your IP address, uses it only to limit spam, and leaves it out of the email.
familytree.feedback.error.too_long: Shorten the message to 2,000 characters or fewer.
familytree.feedback.error.spam: This looks like spam, so it wasn't sent. Remove the links and try again.
familytree.feedback.error.rate_limited: Too many messages came from your network. Try again later.
familytree.feedback.error.cooldown: Wait a minute before sending another message.
familytree.feedback.error.invalid: The feedback server rejected this message. Update Family Tree and try again.
familytree.feedback.error.unavailable: The feedback server is unavailable. Try again later.
familytree.feedback.error.timeout: The feedback server didn't answer in time. Try again later.
familytree.feedback.error.network: Couldn't reach the feedback server. Check your internet connection.
familytree.planner.button.hint: Predict a foal from the selected animal and a mate. Shift-click a second card first to plan that pair.
familytree.planner.title: Breeding planner
familytree.planner.empty: Choose two animals that can breed together. A horse and a donkey make a mule.
familytree.planner.maybe_foal: %s may still be a foal. Foals can't breed until they grow up.
familytree.planner.inbreeding.note: Vanilla Minecraft ignores inbreeding, so this is information, not a penalty.
familytree.planner.stats.hint: The game rolls each stat on its own. Bars show how likely each value is. Green values beat both parents, and the yellow mark is the better parent.
familytree.planner.stats.unknown: %s's stats aren't recorded yet. Family Tree reads them when the animal loads near a player.
familytree.planner.stats.camel: Every camel has the same stats, so the foal will match its parents.
familytree.planner.note.either_parent: The foal takes either parent's coat, each half the time.
familytree.planner.note.frog: Frog colors aren't predicted, because a frog's color depends on the biome where its tadpole grows up.
familytree.planner.note.rabbit: 1 time in 20, a baby rabbit gets a coat picked by the biome where it's born.
familytree.planner.note.modded: Family Tree can't predict variants for animals from other mods.
familytree.planner.note.unknown_parent: A parent's variant isn't recorded yet, so variant odds aren't shown.
familytree.best.title: Best pairs
familytree.best.rank.hint: Pairs are ranked by the foal's expected value. Overall averages speed, jump, and health, each as a share of the game's range. For llamas it uses chest slots and health.
familytree.best.relatives.hint: Skip close leaves out pairs whose foal would be 1/8 inbred or more, such as half siblings, a parent and its foal, or full siblings. Skip all leaves out every known relative.
familytree.best.owners.hint: Same owner pairs animals that belong to one player. Only mine uses your own animals.
familytree.best.summary: Best of %s pairs from %s living adults. Animals born in the last two days may still be foals and are left out.
familytree.best.summary_trimmed: Best of %s pairs from the top %s living adults by this stat.
familytree.best.no_herd: Best pairs needs two living adult horses, donkeys, or llamas with recorded stats.
familytree.kin.title: %s and %s
familytree.kin.unrelated: %1$s and %2$s are not related as far as Family Tree knows.
familytree.kin.distant_aunt: %1$s is a sibling of %2$s's ancestor %3$s generations back.
familytree.kin.plan_hint: Choose Plan breeding to see the foal's odds.
familytree.kin.compare_hint: Shift-click a highlighted card again to stop comparing.
familytree.screen.tree.controls_compare: Click to select, Shift-click to compare, double-click to open a tree
familytree.command.info.help.breed: /familytree breed <a> <b> predicts a foal's stats and variant and says how the two animals are related.
familytree.menu.plan.hint: Choose a mate, then read the foal's odds in a book
familytree.menu.plan.title: Mate for %s
familytree.menu.plan.choose: Click to plan a foal with this mate
familytree.menu.plan.none: No living animal you can see can breed with this one.
familytree.relatives.label: %s · %s
familytree.relatives.look: Look at an animal to see its relatives nearby.
familytree.relatives.none: No relatives of %s are loaded nearby.
familytree.relatives.count_capped: Relatives of %1$s nearby: %2$s, showing the closest %3$s
familytree.relatives.not_tracked: Family Tree has no history you can see for this animal.
familytree.relatives.unavailable: This world's Family Tree data uses an unsupported format, so relatives can't be shown.
familytree.relatives.no_server: This server doesn't have Family Tree, so relatives can't be shown.
familytree.relatives.outdated: This server runs an older Family Tree that can't show relatives in the world.
familytree.help.relatives: Hold %s and look at an animal to light up its relatives nearby. Parents, children, siblings, grandparents, and grandchildren each get a color and a label, and particle lines lead to parents and children.
familytree.menu.relatives.hint: Marks relatives loaded nearby with colored particles and lists them in chat.
familytree.menu.relatives.far: %s needs to be loaded within 64 blocks of you.
